acceptanceCriteria.statement: The bake has a lifetime and a thread. ONE worker request per body carries the whole route bundle (province + relief + crater + carve + ribbon arrays, transferred); the frame after the reply bakes every cube once and parents the ribbon; dispose releases every cube and the ribbon's geometry, material and child link exactly once; a reply after dispose is dropped; a failed worker falls back to the synchronous path. Every cost is RECORDED, never gated.
